posts.name: RAHUL KUMAR
posts.cooked:
Hello Sir,

I had originally completed the BPT1 problems earlier (around Feb 22) while practicing on the VM. Later, when I noticed that BPT1 was showing “Absent”, I re-ran synchro eval to check whether the evaluation scripts were working correctly. Running synchro eval again seems to have updated the timestamps in synchro status, which is why the current timestamps show March.

I have attached the screenshot of the current synchro status. Could you please check if the earlier activity or VM logs indicate that the problems were solved before the deadline?
